note: hand-written before any round-5 extractor code ran, by reading the Go (the fixture is read, not run). Each case is a module under this directory. An rpc entry is a state string or an object of the facts compared exactly (state, codes, unread = a grpc_code_not_literal item, auth, tables, writes as table:op, custom_options).

opt.why: the gate skips its token check when the method's audience option is ANONYMOUS (read by a helper with a namespace guard that no rpc of the module trips). Login carries ANONYMOUS: Public. Info has no option: the enum's zero value: Member. Staff has STAFF: Member. Odd has an aggregate value the proto reader cannot record: unclear

optne.why: the skip condition is audience != MEMBER: Members carries MEMBER and is gated (Member); Lobby has no option, the zero value is not MEMBER, so it skips the check (Public)

skipregistry.why: the skip condition is a registry lookup on the method: not enumerated, so every rpc is unclear

skipflow.why: the method is handed to a helper whose answer decides the skip (the round-4 empty-allowlist shape): an unenumerated bypass, so never Member: unclear

noskip.why: the gate has no skip condition at all: the empty allowlist is literal, every rpc is Member
